Sclerotinia is renowned for producing abundant pure-white mycelium on stems that can later develop into black sclerotia. The way the mycelium erupts and spreads from the green stem tissue is highly characteristic of early Sclerotinia colonization, often seen in moist-chamber incubation used for disease confirmation.
